prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a polished complete native Vue 3 MajorPilot report reader screen, part of one coordinated desktop/report-detail/comparison/mobile set. The reference is the existing MajorPilot editorial brand, not a layout to copy literally. Preserve its existing blue-orange plane logo, paper #F7F5EE, ink #171A1D, electric blue #304FFE, orange #F45B35, thin gray rules, Chinese editorial serif large headings and readable sans body. This is a private evidence report for prospective postgraduate students, not a dashboard, assessment score or marketing page. Code-native HTML text, controls and tables, no raster UI. Open longitudinal reading layout, no cards, shadows, gradients, pills, eyebrow, score, radar chart, ranking, personality/admission/career judgment. Never invent results beyond the quoted sample text. Desktop 1536x1024: quiet 88px brand header, right "个人主页" and outlined "打印"; max-width1400 with68px outer margins; left216px contents rail, thin vertical divider, main content max900px with56px gutter. Header not workspace task shell, no hint pane. Title40px serif, section28px, body18px, controls16px, captions14px. Report and print are authenticated. Fact/self-report/interpretation/limitation use readable text labels, not color alone. Nine experience contents labels: 体验概览,你完成了什么,体验偏好,当前准备度,本次任务表现,专业工作方式连接,证据和结论边界,另外两个专业的差异,下一次体验建议. A plain footer note "布局示例，不代表真实学生报告" makes these concepts honest, not a hero eyebrow. No extra sections or social sharing. Native controls and whitespace must be buildable and clear. Show first viewport. H1 "Data Science 体验报告". Under it exact warning "这是一次体验总结，不是专业适配度测试或录取判断。" Then restrained metadata "任务版本 1.0.0 · 报告版本 1 · 2026-09-21". Short context "学习数据质量与关系分析 · 合成数据 · 逐层提示可用". Main sections visible: 01 "你完成了什么" with 3 open ruled rows, each plain blue label "事实", sample statements "你完成了数据质量检查。","你比较了变量关系和分层结果。","你提交了分析结论与体验反思。" Each right-side text button "查看依据". Then02 "体验偏好" with label "你的自述" and text "你表示愿意继续类似的数据分析任务。" Show open evidence disclosure immediately below one fact: "依据：本次已完成步骤及服务端复核结果。" No internal IDs. Next visible section03 "当前准备度" with short sample "本次操作不等于在新数据中已经可以独立完成分析。" label "限制". Current left rail uses thin blue line/text, no filled blocks. Full header and page flow, generous reading spacing.
